newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel diamond exports fell 8 percent in November.
newsitem.headline: Israel diamond exports fell 8 percent in November.

text.p: Israel's net exports of polished diamonds fell eight percent in November from a year earlier to $377 million from $409 million, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Sunday.
The head of the diamond unit at the ministry noted that November marks the final month of the pre-Christmas season for diamond exports and that exports began falling off towards the end of the month.
In the first 11 months of the year exports of polished diamonds came to $3.769 billion, up five percent from $3.601 billion a year earlier.
Exports of uncut or partially cut diamonds rose 20 percent on the year to $762 million in the 10 months from $635 million.
Exports to the United States, Israel's main market, rose in November, offsetting a decline in sales to Japan, the second-largest export destination.
